title: G6 transmitter deaths after 25 and 24 days
symptom: G6 transmitters are dying after about 25 days of use. xDrip stops receiving data, system status shows 'Scanning…', and the transmitter's Bluetooth device cannot be found by other devices.
fix: The user resolved the issue by buying a newer phone with Android 9, running the same xDrip version, and it has been running fine since then.
evidence_quote: I had to buy a newer phone with android9. Running fine since then, with the same xDrip version.
